authority: historical/symbolic reference registry for Arcanum research; not doctrine, empirical physics, participant typing, recognition, authority, or a claim that Hebrew letters possess fixed intrinsic frequencies
purpose: Preserve the historically grounded structural features of the twenty-two foundation letters that are relevant to Tree-path, voice, breath, articulation, combination, and future sonification studies without inventing sacred-Hz correspondences.

primary_text_reference: Sefer Yetzirah 1-2: ten sefirot and twenty-two foundation letters; three Mothers, seven Doubles, twelve Simple letters.
Sefer Yetzirah 2: letters described as engraved/carved with voice and breath and set in the mouth in five articulation places.
Sefer Yetzirah 2: twenty-two letters fixed in a wheel with 231 gates, turning forward and backward.

articulation_groups.historical_posture: throat/guttural grouping in the cited Sefer Yetzirah recension
palate grouping in the cited recension
tongue/lingual grouping in the cited recension
teeth/dental grouping in the cited recension
lips/labial grouping in the cited recension

wheel.graph_model: complete undirected pair graph K22 as a modern mathematical representation of all unique two-letter pairings
wheel.historical_language: wheel / 231 gates / forward and backward combination
wheel.interpretation: The letter wheel treats letters as combinable nodes; the later Tree model may treat the same twenty-two letters as relationship/path classes. These are different information roles and must not be collapsed.

voice_breath_posture.source_meaning: letters are described through voice, breath/spirit, and bodily articulation
voice_breath_posture.safe_arcanum_interpretation: phonation and articulation provide a legitimate acoustic/embodied dimension for study and optional sonification
unsafe_inference: each letter has one scientifically established sacred frequency
a participant's body or identity can be diagnosed from a letter frequency
specific hertz values confer recognition, readiness, healing, authority, or destiny

flame_language_caution.primary_observation: Sefer Yetzirah 1:7 compares the end and beginning of the ten sefirot to a flame bound to a coal.
flame_language_caution.textual_variant_observation: A later/variant presentation associated with the articulation passage also contains flame-to-coal language about the tongue; the Sefaria editorial note warns that this addition is not actually present in the cited 1562 Mantua printing despite a later editor's claim.
flame_language_caution.design_posture: Use flame imagery only as explicitly labeled interpretive/historical variant metadata, never as proof of an intrinsic frequency system.

candidate_laws: Voice Before Frequency — historical acoustic evidence begins with voice, breath, and articulation, not invented hertz values.
Letter Role Is Contextual — a letter may be a node in the 231-gate wheel and an edge/operator in a Tree projection without those graph roles being identical.
Combination Is Not Completion — 231 possible pairings are a combinatorial field, not a curriculum checklist.
Textual Variant Must Stay Visible — later additions and differing recensions may inform research but may not be silently presented as a single ancient wording.
